name: Unusually low wages, deductions or accommodation charges
description: Pay after deductions is far below minimum wage standards; heavy deductions for housing, food and transport.
fp: Statutory deductions and employer housing are lawful.

sources.text: ILO, Profits and Poverty: The Economics of Forced Labour (2014)
OECD, Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (2018)
FATF and APG, Financial Flows from Human Trafficking (2018)
